package.description: 基于自定义规则的番剧采集与在线观看应用。

en-US.description: A rule-based anime collection and streaming application.
en-US.longDescription: Kazumi is a Flutter-based application for collecting and streaming anime from custom rules. It supports online streaming, danmaku (bullet comments), and real-time super resolution based on Anime4K. Rules can be built with up to five lines of XPath-based selectors, and rule import and sharing are supported.

zh-CN.description: 基于自定义规则的番剧采集与在线观看应用。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kazumi 是一个使用 Flutter 开发的基于自定义规则的番剧采集与在线观看程序，支持流媒体在线观看、弹幕和基于 Anime4K 的实时超分辨率。它支持使用基于 XPath 语法的最多五行选择器构建自己的规则，并支持规则导入与规则分享。
zh-CN.name: Kazumi
